title: Sun
author: Eva Petropoulou-Lianou
text:
Gratitude the word
I seek
People change during the spring
They fell in love with each other
They fell in love with themselves

Sun,
My face you touch
As a great protector
I feel the power of the heat

The world will change one day
When the people become
Generous as the Sun
stanzas: They fell in love with each other
They fell in love with themselves
I feel the power of the heat
The world will change one day
